payload.reason: The evidence provides information about the performance results of models using oversampled datasets compared to their counterparts, indicating improved performance due to addressing class imbalance.

claims.text: Oversampled datasets (F+, T+, W+) show significantly better performance than their non-oversampled counterparts (F, T, W).
The models faced a class imbalance issue, leading to a bias towards labeling posts as non-bullying.
